detail: Full summary: Subagent-driven phase retro: 6 tasks, 6 reviews, 1 Critical caught and fixed (depth-2 overflow shape), 2 plan defects caught by review (wiring snippet bug, 4-key counts contract), 1 report inaccuracy caught (test count).
